title: IoT Sensor Data Stream
description: Real-time data stream from IoT sensors monitoring infrastructure conditions, equipment performance, and environmental factors
purpose: Enable predictive maintenance, real-time monitoring, and operational optimization through continuous sensor data
format: JSON message streams via Apache Kafka, time-series database storage
volume: 10GB daily from 5,000 sensors generating 1M messages per hour
retention: Real-time for 30 days, aggregated for 2 years, archived for 7 years
sources: Temperature sensors, vibration monitors, GPS trackers, environmental sensors
consumers: Predictive maintenance system, real-time dashboards, alert systems, analytics platform
security: Encrypted transmission, device authentication, network segmentation
analytics: Anomaly detection, predictive modeling, trend analysis, real-time alerting
businessValue: Prevents $2M annually in equipment failures through predictive maintenance

informationElements.title: Temperature Readings
informationElements.purpose: Detect overheating equipment early to prevent failures
informationElements.dataType: FLOAT with timestamp and sensor ID
